summary: Preserve correction expiry and bounded suggestion results

changes.title: Keep correction rejection cleanup on its original deadline
changes.detail: Keep the original 30-second correction rejection deadline scheduled across unrelated words and different proposed replacements. Consume the receipt only for the exact rejected pair; editor, connection, expiry and privacy invalidation clear it. The receipt remains RAM-only and unrelated input never extends its lifetime.

changes.title: Prevent duplicate candidates from shrinking suggestions
changes.detail: At capacity, a comparator-equal duplicate is rejected without evicting an existing candidate. Better unique candidates still replace the lowest-ranked item, while worse candidates leave the native ranked set unchanged.
